description: This file implements the functionality of a wait queue in a multi-threaded event-driven environment, including initialization, push, pop, removal, and update methods for wait queue elements, along with timer handling logic.

methods.name: void wq_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer event occurs, which calls the user-provided callback with the wait queue and data.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_init(liWaitQueue * queue,liEventLoop * loop,const char * waitqueue_name,liWaitQueueCB callback,gdouble delay,gpointer data)
methods.description: Initializes a wait queue with the event loop, wait queue name, callback, delay, and user data.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_set_delay(liWaitQueue * queue,gdouble delay)
methods.description: Sets a new delay for the wait queue and updates the timer accordingly if active.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_update(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Recalculates and adjusts the wait queue timer based on the current head element and delay.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_push(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem * elem)
methods.description: Adds a new element to the wait queue, adjusting the timer if necessary.

methods.name: liWaitQueueElem * li_waitqueue_pop(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest element in the queue if its timestamp plus delay is less than the current time.

methods.name: liWaitQueueElem * li_waitqueue_pop_force(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest element in the queue regardless of timestamp or delay.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_remove(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem * elem)
methods.description: Removes a specific element from the queue and updates the timer if the queue becomes empty.

methods.name: guint li_waitqueue_pop_ready(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem ** head)
methods.description: Processes elements that are ready based on their timestamps and the delay, returning how many elements are processed and updating the head pointer.

ctags.name: li_waitqueue_init
ctags.signature: (liWaitQueue * queue,liEventLoop * loop,const char * waitqueue_name,liWaitQueueCB callback,gdouble delay,gpointer data)
